tonight.headline: Warren plays tonight; Jefferson still unpriced
body: Week 4 starts tonight: Jaylen Warren at Cleveland, 18:15, with Rico Dowdle ruled out. ESPN has you at 129.6 against Aye-Aye's 125.1, 52%. The bad news hasn't changed: Justin Jefferson didn't practise Wednesday and ESPN still projects him at 18.7.
Nothing to do today. You added Jordan Addison overnight, which settles the Jefferson cover: if he's inactive at 12:35 Sunday, Addison takes his slot. No add needed.

case.label: The risk
case.body: Jefferson's 18.7 is the number most likely to be wrong in this matchup. O'Connell called him 'feeling a little bit better' but wouldn't talk about the weekend (FOX 9, 30 Sep). Thursday's practice report decides how worried to be.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Aye-Aye start Herbert (12.7), McCaffrey, Jeremiyah Love, Kyren Williams, St. Brown, McMillan, Tyler Warren and the Eagles D/ST. McCaffrey was a rest-day DNP for San Francisco Wednesday (49ers Webzone), not an injury.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jefferson limited Thursday and full Friday: then he plays and nothing fires.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · if Jefferson is inactive at Sun 12:35 Mexico City
doFirst.title: If Jefferson is inactive: start Addison in his slot
doFirst.subtitle: Replaces both of yesterday's Jefferson cards. Addison is already yours, so it's a swap, not an add.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Right-ankle sprain on his seventh snap against Tampa Bay; DNP Wednesday. O'Connell: 'encouraged about what it actually is' but 'not in any place right now to talk about what that means for the weekend' (FOX 9, Vikings.com 30 Sep). ESPN still 18.7: not priced.

case.label: Why Addison, not Coker
case.body: lineup_check.py names Coker (13.0 to Addison's 11.6). But Coker's quad kept him out Wednesday too, and his inactives come at 16:50, after the Vikings kick off at 14:05. If you start a questionable Coker and he sits, the slot scores zero. Addison is in Jefferson's game and his role is Jefferson's absence: 9 targets in Week 3 after Jefferson left (archive).

case.label: The exception
case.body: If Coker comes off Friday's report and ESPN projects him above Addison at 12:35, take the projection and start Coker.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: It fires and Addison scores less than Coker that week.

doFirst.sources: FOX 9 · Vikings.com · SI Panthers · lineup_check.py · Week 3 archive

whatWentWrong.title: Jefferson missed Wednesday and the projection still hasn't noticed
whatWentWrong.lead: 18.7 before the DNP, 18.7 now. That gap is why the Addison card exists.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Vikings Wednesday report: DNP (ankle). O'Connell won't rush him back before he can 'go be himself' (Vikings.com 30 Sep).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Limited Thursday, full Friday: the card stays unarmed.

whatWentWrong.title: The Addison move happened early, and dropped Boston instead of Monangai
whatWentWrong.lead: Yesterday's plan was to add him only if Jefferson sat, for Monangai. You added him at 01:16 for Denzel Boston. It works: Boston played Thursday and couldn't cover a Sunday inactive.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The Jefferson contingency is now a bench swap at 12:35, not a waiver move. Boston is on waivers until 7 Oct if you want him back.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jefferson active Sunday: then Addison is a bench receiver and the decision log grades the early add against Boston.

doNotChase.name: Jaylen Wright
doNotChase.lead: The wire's biggest RB riser, and he's the man splitting Gordon's work.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Back to limited practice Wednesday with the foot (Vikings.com 30 Sep). SI has him ahead of Gordon on the depth chart, with Gordon on the goal line.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: He'd be your sixth back, splitting a Miami backfield you already own half of, at Minnesota, who allow the 4th-fewest points to RBs (footballdb).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Wright takes over outright in Week 4 (Gordon under 8 touches): then the Gordon claim is the thing to revisit, not a reason to own both.

case.label: The number that kills it

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Likely on a Giants injury report.

waiverAnalysis.summary: Nothing on the wire beats this roster on usage, from three weeks of data, which is still thin. Meyers, yesterday's riser, no longer clears the bar now that Addison (not Boston) is the weakest movable receiver.
